* Chapter 11: ''[[GB11|Gold and Black VS. Team Rocket]]''
* Chapter 12: ''[[GB12|The Legendary Pokémon]]''
* Chapter 13: ''[[GB13|A Promise Given To Miltank]]''
* Chapter 14: ''[[GB14|Let's Fight! The Mini Pokémon Tournament]]''
* Chapter 15: ''[[GB15|Escape From The Mystery Forest!]]''
* Chapter 16: ''[[GB16|The New Pokémon Is Hatched!!]]''

==Important events==
* {{GnB|Gold}} wins a tournament held by the [[Pokémon Day Care]] and receives a {{p|Tyrogue}}.
* Gold encounters {{GnB|Grey}} for the first time.
* Gold meets the three legendary beasts: {{p|Raikou}}, {{p|Entei}} and {{p|Suicune}}.
* Gold earns the {{Badge|Plain}} and the {{Badge|Fog}}.
* Gold meets {{GnB|Chris}} for the first time.
